<<<PAGE 418>>>
• Clearing & Settlement Charges: Increased by 55.82% to ₹1,250.84 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹802.76 million in
Fiscal 2025, primarily due to increase in trading volumes cleared on the other clearing corporation, other than by NCL
and NSEICC.
• Technology expenses: Our technology related expenses increased in Fiscal 2026, primarily due to an increase in the
following other expenses:
- Repairs and maintenance (to computers, trading & telecommunication systems): Increased by 72.70% to
₹3,153.41 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹1,825.94 million in Fiscal 2025, primarily due to an increase in annual
maintenance costs for hardware and software deployed for our operations largely driven by segregation of our
technology related infrastructure across the group. Further there was a change in accounting treatment of the fees
paid to NSEIT on account of NSEIT ceasing to be a subsidiary of our Company pursuant to its divestment under
the share purchase agreement dated January 31, 2025.
- IT Vendor Resources Expenses: Increased by 15.59% to ₹3,505.27 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹3,032.56 million
in Fiscal 2025, primarily due to an increase in outsourcing services for IT infrastructure maintenance.
- IT management and consultancy charges: Increased by 21.25% to ₹1,294.87 million in Fiscal 2026 from
₹1,067.96 million in Fiscal 2025, primarily attributable to technology centre of excellence applications going live
for NCL and increased colocation rack management charges.
- Software expenses: Increased by 27.31% to ₹3,625.38 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹2,847.75 million in Fiscal
2025, primarily on account of higher costs incurred for additional software licences that we licensed from third
parties for our growing operations; and
- Lease line charges: Increased by 11.56% to ₹800.74 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹717.79 million in Fiscal 2025.
Contribution to Core SGF
Our contribution to Core SGF decreased by 99.75% to ₹5.76 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹2,340.89 million in Fiscal 2025,
primarily because, our Board approved discontinuation of the voluntary contribution to Core SGF with effect from January 1,
2025, as we had achieved the required contribution under the regulations. Accordingly, during Fiscal 2026, our Company
contributed a lower amount towards Core SGF compared to Fiscal 2025.
Exceptional items
Our profit on the sale of investment in associates, reported as exceptional items, was ₹12,009.41 million during Fiscal 2026,
arising from the sale of a 9% stake in National Securities Depository Limited through an offer for sale, pursuant to the
requirement under the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 to reduce our shareholding from 24% to 15%.
In comparison, the profit on the sale of investment in associates was ₹12,094.72 million in Fiscal 2025, which comprised a
gain of ₹11,549.28 million from the divestment of the entire 20.34% stake held by NSE Investments in Protean eGov
Technologies Limited and a gain of ₹545.44 million from the divestment of a 4.21% stake held by NSE Investments in Power
Exchange India Limited. We also incurred one-time expenses of ₹1,264.41 million during Fiscal 2026 on account of an
incremental provision for gratuity (past service cost) arising from the notification of the new Labour Code on November 21,
2025, which we reported as an exceptional item in our restated consolidated statement of profit and loss.
Tax expenses
Our total tax expenses decreased by 3.95% to ₹37,160.50 million in Fiscal 2026 from ₹38,690.30 million in Fiscal 2025,
primarily due to reduction in profit before tax from Continuing Operations. The effective tax rate in Fiscal 2026 was 26.74%
compared to 25.00% in Fiscal 2025.
Profit for the year from Continuing Operations
For the foregoing reasons, our profit for the year from Continuing Operations decreased by 12.29% to ₹101,795.29 million in
Fiscal 2026 from ₹116,057.48 million in Fiscal 2025.
Fiscal 2025 compared to Fiscal 2024
Income
Our total income increased by 17.27% to ₹191,768.31 million in Fiscal 2025 from ₹163,520.62 million in Fiscal 2024, primarily
due to increase in transaction charges, Data Feed & Terminal services, Clearing & Settlement Services and other operating
income.
